title: place_router silently coerces unparseable x/y coordinates to 0
detail: The parse-error is discarded (_); a non-numeric tile coord sets x/y to 0 instead of failing. This violates the file's own strict-parse contract ("a typo'd demo must fail loudly"); a typo'd coord places the router at origin.
recommended_fix: Check the bool return: `v, ok := strconv.parse_i64(fields[2]); if !ok { return it, fmt.tprintf(...) }` for both x and y.

title: verify_replay hardcodes bare=false; a `map bare` demo with intents replays against the wrong fixture
evidence:
bar := false
	_ = bar
	replayed, ok := replay_hashes(log_path, catalogs, u64(len(live_hashes)), false, &fails)
detail: replay_hashes takes a `bare` flag (selects run_context_create_bare), but verify_replay passes false literally; the dead `bar` shows the flag was meant to be wired. A bare demo with commands diverges on replay with a misleading message.
recommended_fix: Plumb the demo's map_fixture through to verify_replay and pass `bare = (demo.map_fixture == "bare")` into replay_hashes; assert bare demos with commands are covered.

title: run_replay checks only min(len) ticks; a short replay would skip the tail and report success
detail: Unlike verify_replay (line 125 asserts len equality before comparing), run_replay uses min() with no length assert, so a short replay array would verify only the overlap then return 0. Latent today (replay_hashes returns ok only at full length) but the guard is absent.
recommended_fix: Add `if len(replayed) != len(man.hashes) { ... return 1 }` before the loop, mirroring verify_replay, then compare full slices.
